environment.project: isolated empty projects and native editor/runtime fixtures only

verifiedReal: Official MCP discovers import_project_png with write+run permission; bad format, invalid CRC, stale hash, denied permission and declined approval do not write target files

Exact PNG source bytes are SHA-256-bound in approval/rollback journal and imported/loaded in a disposable native Godot project before commit; a live opted-in editor scans and confirms Texture2D without a fixed completion sleep

A 2D UI/combat slice starts with an empty test project; MCP creates scene/script and imports texture, native editor authors HUD/collision/position animation, save/reopen succeeds, exact scene write adds navigation and sprite, runtime input increments hits and yields a 2D path, then approved scene rename updates project.godot main_scene

A 3D interaction slice starts with an empty test project; native editor authors material/mesh/collision/ray/camera/local Vector3 position animation, invalid key dimension fails without partial authoring, save/reopen succeeds, exact scene write adds navigation, and runtime input, ray hit and 3D path are observed
Only byte-identical bundled plugin scripts without the moved path/UID bypass an unrelated dynamic-load move heuristic; altered plugin scripts still conflict
approval: MOCK form acceptance in isolated tests, not human approval
failedChecksRetained: First PNG fixture had a bad CRC; native isolated import correctly rejected it and preserved the original project
First live editor test found a GDScript type-inference compilation error in asset_import.gd; the raw editor log remains in the isolated fixture

First content slice tried structured authoring on scripted or unsupported graph nodes; the editor correctly refused. Final workflow uses only declared native nodes, with separate approved text candidates for script/navigation/imported Sprite2D
First 3D navigation observation was empty until the runtime called the native path update after map synchronization; the test now waits for actual navigation readiness
limitations: Only default PNG importer, strict base64 <=2 MiB, image dimensions <=4096; no custom importer, arbitrary host source path, asset rename or binary format family

Navigation, sprite and gameplay script attachments in these slices are exact approved .tscn/.gd candidate files, not structured editor graph operations; general scripted/unknown editor documents remain read-only for native authoring
Only local Node2D/Vector2 and Node3D/Vector3 position animation tracks; no skeletal/method/audio tracks or general graph families
Native editor synchronization is a separate post-commit observation and can be NOT_OBSERVED without misreporting durable disk commit as rollback
Only Windows/Godot 4.7.2 isolated fixtures are qualified; form approval is MOCK and user real projects were not changed
G3-G6 and T22-T35 still require separate gates; default run registry recovery defect remains assigned to T31, so production stays NOT_QUALIFIED
